evidence.summary: Sensor data for unit U009 shows filter differential pressure (filter_dp_bar) increased 12.7% to 0.464 bar (z=2.3) while coolant flow decreased 2.2% to 39.27 L/min (z=-2.0); load_pct also down 4.6%.
Remaining useful life estimated at 78 cycles, policy band 'above_50_monitor' indicating monitoring but not immediate failure.
SOP-C-202 describes filter differential pressure above 0.7 bar and falling coolant flow as symptoms of coolant filter clog.
High filter differential pressure with normal inlet pressure points to a loaded filter cartridge, matching observed elevated filter_dp_bar with normal inlet pressure.

report.summary: Unit U009 exhibited an anomaly score of 0.776, driven by a 12.7% rise in filter differential pressure and a 2.2% drop in coolant flow. These sensor deviations align with SOP-C-202 symptoms for a coolant filter clog, where differential pressure rises while flow declines. RUL estimation shows 78 cycles remaining, placing the unit in a monitoring band. The most probable root cause is a developing filter clog; recommend inspecting and cleaning the coolant filter per SOP-C-202.
